seo.title: Help and FAQs | Big Jo’s Paints
seo.description: How the AI colour consultant works, how we work out how much paint you need, delivery in 3 days, payment and your photo.

faqs.question: How does the AI choose my colours?
faqs.answer: It looks at your photo (the light, floors, furniture and colours already in the room) and reads your brief. Then it picks three colours from our catalogue of real brand colours, and a suitable paint for each. It never makes up a colour.

faqs.question: How do you work out how much paint I need?
faqs.answer: We work out your wall area from the room size: the length and width of the room times the ceiling height, less a door and a window. We allow two coats plus 10% extra for cutting in and touch-ups, then choose the cheapest mix of tins that covers it.

faqs.question: Will the colour look the same on my wall?
faqs.answer: Screens show colours differently, and daylight changes them through the day. Use the swatch as a guide and paint a test patch before you do the whole room. Most colours have a sample pot you can order with your paint or on its own.

faqs.question: Can I order a sample first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plascon and Duram make sample pots, from R36 for a 90 ml Duram Habitat sample to R89 for a 250 ml tester in a deep colour, and each colour page shows the one we can send in that colour. Prominent Paints doesn’t make sample pots, so its colour pages offer the smallest tin, 1 litre, instead. Samples are delivered in 3 days, like paint.

faqs.question: How fast is delivery?
faqs.answer: Your paint is delivered in 3 days.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Securely online through PayFast, by card or Instant EFT. We never see your card or banking details.

faqs.question: What happens to my photo?
faqs.answer: We send it to OpenAI only to get your colour suggestions, and we don’t keep it. OpenAI doesn’t use it to train its models.
